prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production reference sheet for an existing grounded 3D planetary wilderness game, ecology R4. Generate ONE landscape sheet showing THREE distinct natural tree species and three age/structure variants EACH, nine isolated full trees at consistent human-scale ruler. Species A upland pine: straight taper trunk, irregular whorled asymmetric needle boughs, juvenile sparse spire / mature broken-tier crown / old wind-pruned fork. Species B temperate oak: crooked trunk, articulated spreading forks and lobed leaves, juvenile / mature broad crown / veteran hollow crooked crown. Species C moist-river alder: multiple slender trunks, ascending forks and small oval leaves, juvenile / mature multi-stem / old leaning coppice. Physically plausible taper, branch attachment, sparse interior gaps, visible buttress or lateral roots attached at base. Each species must have clearly different silhouette and actual branching architecture, not same tree scaled. Neutral slate studio backdrop, consistent front three-quarter orthographic camera, matte bark and subdued green leaves, natural game art geometry detail, small front and side silhouette thumbnails per species. No people, no fantasy crystals, no buildings, no text paragraphs. Labels only: PINE / OAK / ALDER and YOUNG / MATURE / OLD. Emphasize buildable mesh anatomy and leaf placement.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 3D ecological tree construction sheet R4. ONE landscape technical art plate with three columns PINE / OAK / ALDER, same upright local gravity. Each column shows an anatomically plausible fully branched trunk with transparent ghost crown, actual rooted base on slight soil slope, front and side views. Pine: tapered single main leader, irregular separated whorls, some dry low branches, radial buttress roots. Oak: crooked taper trunk, non-symmetrical Y forks, numerous smaller forks attaching smoothly, surface flare and lateral roots; no spherical blob canopy. Alder: 3 trunks rising from shared stool, narrower ascending branches, dense fibrous near-surface roots in moist soil; no floating stems. Insets expose branch collar joins, taper ratios from trunk to twigs, leaf cluster at terminal twigs and sparse inner crown gaps. Distinguish young, mature and old structures via small lower silhouette strip. Material palette natural dark grey-brown bark, subdued green leaves. Grounded detailed game asset concept, neutral grey backdrop, uncluttered generous spacing, whole roots visible, coherent same-scale anatomy, no fantasy glow, no humans. Labels sparse English, enough detail to implement visible meshes and trunk/branch capsule collision from actual structure.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: frame-by-frame 3D environmental destruction reference for game ecology R4. ONE landscape image, two horizontal storyboards each six cleanly separated panels of SAME oak tree or SAME branch with unchanged camera and scale. TOP trunk fracture sequence labeled 0.00 / 0.15 / 0.40 / 0.80 / 1.40 / 2.10s: intact crooked oak; horizontal impact from left contacts lower trunk 1m above roots exposing pale fibers and bark chips; fracture opens on struck side while rear hinge remains; crown/trunk pivots right away from impact around actual hinge with gravity arc; crown and branches contact ground on slight slope, secondary small splinters; settled diagonal fallen trunk resting on ground, stable low jagged stump remains rooted. Ghost trajectories only thin diagram arrows, no magic beam. Keep falling assembly rigid with coherent branch attachments, angular acceleration, no teleport or scale change. BOTTOM branch sequence: intact distinct outer branch of standing oak / localized hit on branch collar / wood fibers snap / severed branch with attached leaves rotates downward / branch strikes soil and scatters a few wood chips / settled detached branch, tree trunk and other branches stay intact. Include small cross-section closeups of rough break surfaces with bark ring and inner wood. Natural bark, muted leaves, neutral slate background. Buildable physically plausible asset keyframes, full swept fall path visible, do not crop trees or fragment travel. No character or gore.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: destructible rock mass production sheet ecology R4. ONE landscape plate with upper six sequential panels of SAME irregular layered basalt outcrop, 5m high and 7m wide, camera locked front three-quarter, grey soil, local gravity down. Sequence intact weathered faceted multi-block mass / directed impact from left creates branching cracks only at contact / major seam opens into interlocking angular blocks with fresh dark inner faces / strongest impact ejects 6 to 10 LARGE angular chunks and a few small shards with short motion arcs / gravity drops chunks onto nearby ground / settled rubble exposes low embedded irregular rock base. Show finite affected outcrop, surrounding ground remains continuous unchanged. Do NOT depict arbitrary planet-wide terrain excavation. Lower panels: exploded view of six interlocking separately meshable fracture chunks; side view and top view; detail of rough external weathering vs newly fractured inner grain; three sizes of splinter meshes for pooled short-lived debris. Buildable authored fracture shapes, not cubes/spheres, no lava, no glowing runes, no people. Lighting clear for surface reading, natural slate/charcoal/taupe palette, sparse English labels 0.0s 0.1s 0.3s 0.6s 1.2s 2.0s.
